technique_name: Create a story about an elephant for a child aged four.
description: Once upon a time, there was an elephant named Elmer who lived in the jungle. Elmer was a big, gray elephant with long eyelashes and a trunk that was always ready for a hug. Every morning, Elmer would go on a long walk around the forest with his friends: the giraffe, the zebra, and the lion. On their way, they would visit the river and make new friends.
